Section: section_1 — Prerequisite Review: Vectors as Arrows

Vectors are directed segments in 2D space.
Moving: v = [2, 1] means right 2, up 1.
Scaling and adding vectors build everything.

Planned animations:
Create two 2D arrows (vector v: #FF5733, vector w: #33FF57) at origin.
Fade in vector v from origin to coordinate (2,1). Label it 'v'.
Fade in vector w from origin to coordinate (-1,2). Label it 'w'.
Animate sum v+w as a new arrow (result: #3357FF) using parallelogram rule.
Highlight vectors v and w with glowing effect (#FFFFFF).

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite Review: Vectors as Arrows", [
            "Vectors are directed segments in 2D space.",
            "Moving: v = [2, 1] means right 2, up 1.",
            "Scaling and adding vectors build everything."
        ])

        # Define coordinate axes
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-1, 4, 1], y_range=[-1, 4, 1], axis_config={"include_tip": True}).scale(0.5)
        self.place_in_area(axes, 'A1', 'F6', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.add(axes)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Create vectors
        v_coords = [2, 1]
        w_coords = [-1, 2]
        
        v = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=axes.c2p(*v_coords), color="#FF5733", buff=0)
        w = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=axes.c2p(*w_coords), color="#33FF57", buff=0)
        
        v_label = MathTex(r"\vec{v}", color="#FF5733").next_to(v.get_end(), RIGHT)
        w_label = MathTex(r"\vec{w}", color="#33FF57").next_to(w.get_end(), LEFT)
        
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF5733")
        self.play(FadeIn(v), Write(v_label))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#33FF57")
        self.play(FadeIn(w), Write(w_label))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(WHITE)
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#3357FF")
        
        # Parallelogram Rule
        v_to_w = Arrow(start=v.get_end(), end=axes.c2p(*(np.array(v_coords)+np.array(w_coords))), color="#33FF57", buff=0, stroke_opacity=0.5)
        w_to_v = Arrow(start=w.get_end(), end=axes.c2p(*(np.array(v_coords)+np.array(w_coords))), color="#FF5733", buff=0, stroke_opacity=0.5)
        sum_vec = Arrow(start=ORIGIN, end=axes.c2p(*(np.array(v_coords)+np.array(w_coords))), color="#3357FF", buff=0)
        
        self.play(Create(v_to_w), Create(w_to_v), GrowArrow(sum_vec))
        self.play(v.animate.set_color(WHITE), w.animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(1)
